root_cause_criterion.statement: Before assigning replacement content into ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc, fallback handling must break aliasing with fallback->children by storing a different node-list pointer.

nodes.statement: The serializer ns-prefix check reads the prefix from the current node namespace pointer cur->ns.

edges.statement: The pointer stored in ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc becomes the list head consumed by the XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE replacement loop.
The namespace-definition pointer freed while releasing the include-side node is later the same pointer read through cur->ns at the serializer sink.
